rationale: cvrp_parallel_merge_static achieves the best dev_24 quality (raw_mean 16.2225, remaining gap 0.5% postprocess vs CW) while its baseline p95 solve time is 7.0 ms (~1.4% of 500 ms budget; n=200 p95 7.25 ms) with 100% completion, leaving huge safe timing headroom. Dynamic is equally accurate but costs 25 ms p95 with no quality advantage, and sequential_construct lags significantly on dev_24 (bridged gap only 59.8%, 12.6% postprocess drop). Static parallel merge is therefore the optimal choice.
